name: Git Hooks
desc: Scripts for automating tasks during `git` workflows.

resources.name: enforce-insert-issue-number
resources.desc: Make sure user did not delete the ISSUE-\[#] string that was generated by prepare-commit-msg/insert-issue-number.hook.

resources.name: delete-pyc-files
resources.desc: Delete all .pyc files every time a new branch is checked out.

resources.name: new-branch-alert
resources.desc: Display a message when a new branch is checked out for the first time.

resources.name: update-server-info
resources.desc: Prepare a packed repository for use over dumb transports (e.g. http).

resources.name: dotenvx
resources.desc: Prevent committing your .env file(s) to code.

resources.name: format-code
resources.desc: Run command to format code and re-add any files modified after formatting.

resources.name: search-term
resources.desc: Fail commit if a specific term is found in the code.

resources.name: spell-check-md-files
resources.desc: Check files with .md extension for spelling errors.

resources.name: verify-name-and-email
resources.desc: Fail commit if user.name or user.email is incorrect.

resources.name: include-git-diff-name-status
resources.desc: Include the output of "Git diff --name-status -r" into the message, just before the "Git status" output.

resources.name: insert-issue-number
resources.desc: Insert issue number to beginning of the commit message.

resources.name: prevent-bad-push
resources.desc: Prevent push of commits where the log message starts with "WIP" (work in progress).

resources.name: prevent-rebase
resources.desc: Prevent topic branches that are already merged to 'next' branch from getting rebased, because allowing it would result in rebasing already published history.

resources.name: fsmonitor-watchman
resources.desc: Output to stdout all files that have been modified since a given time.

resources.name: update
resources.desc: Block unannotated tags from entering.

resources.name: Husky
resources.desc: Manage Git hooks with a nice user interface.

resources.name: Overcommit
resources.desc: A fully configurable and extendable Git hook manager.

resources.name: Git Build Hook Maven Plugin
resources.desc: Install Git hooks and config during a Maven build.

resources.name: CaptainHook
resources.desc: Git hooks manager for PHP developers.

resources.name: pre-commit
resources.desc: A framework for managing and maintaining multi-language pre-commit hooks.
